main_issue: Who covers Agent D's unfinished analysis section before Thursday's pitch, and whether to ask for an extension or simplify instead of the three splitting it

A-B.evidence: A assigns integration (13) and says 'there isn't another option' (15); B refuses (14, 16), asks for extension or simplified deliverable (24); A says 'No' (26).

A-C.evidence: C initially agreed the issue needed solving (5) but refused the charts (17) and Anil's work (19), then backed an extension (25), which A rejected (26).

A-D.evidence: D agrees to do the handover (8) and A thanks them (9); D never takes a position on A's plan or the extension, and only asks 'no one can take the work?' (20).

B-C.evidence: Both said they lacked capacity (10, 11); C says 'I agree, can we ask for an extension?' (25), echoing B (24).

B-D.evidence: D only asks 'So... no one can take the work?' (20); B's refusals and extension request (24) are not directed at D, and D takes no side on them.

C-D.evidence: D's question (20) follows C's refusal (19), but D takes no stance on the extension (25), so there is no clear relation.
